title: Post-Qualification
description: New since the pre-restructure schema set (migration 0042). The RA 9184 step after Bid Evaluation and before Award/PO: verify the winning bidder's documents, run a site/equipment inspection, check financial capacity (NFCC/SLCC), and record a final Pass/Fail decision. Matches public.post_qualifications, with public.post_qualification_checklist embedded as the `checklist` array. Linked to the winning Supplier or Contractor directly, not to a specific Vendor Bid row. Not wired as a gate on Purchase Orders -- a PO can be created regardless of this record's decision.

winningVendorId.description: FK -> reference-data/vendor.id. Mutually exclusive with winningContractorId.

winningContractorId.description: FK -> reference-data/contractor.id. Mutually exclusive with winningVendorId.

nfccAmount.description: Net Financial Contracting Capacity, checked against the project's approved budget.

slccAmount.description: Single Largest Completed Contract, within the relevant period.

siteInspectionResultId.description: FK -> lookup_options.id, list_key = 'post_qualification_result' (Passed, Failed, Not Applicable).

checklist.description: public.post_qualification_checklist rows -- a plain per-document Pass/Fail scoped to this one winning bidder (unlike the many-bidder Bid Evaluation matrix, only one bidder is ever in play here).
